$comment: The example that shows why this tool exists instead of Docker.
Every latency knob is set, and the service logs what systemd actually applied
— so the log viewer proves the settings reached the host rather than merely
being written into a unit file.
Deploy it with `make example-deploy EXAMPLE=latency-critical`, then read the
logs. Compare against `make example-unit EXAMPLE=latency-critical`, which
prints the unit file nudo would write.
name: latency-critical
description: A latency-sensitive worker, pinned and prioritised
